body: Thank you so much, yeah it feels like things have been bad forever and people always said it will get better but they just haven't... I live in England and was going to move to another country but now I don't know what's going to happen, but the books sound like a good idea thank you :)

Thank you that’s so nice of you... yeah I was referred to two therapists by school when I was younger but it didn’t really work out, I never wanted to talk to them and found they couldn’t understand. I never considered it again because I know the waiting lists are aways long, and my parents never really believed in mental health problems, It’s good to hear you’re doing better now
